action_items: None required — the found bug (RCA below) was fixed by testing agent. Please double-check the try/except added around geocode() call in live_points() at backend/server.py:320-326.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py live_points() cache TTL is 5min per (rounded_lat, rounded_lng, meters). This is good for repeat searches but means clients switching between radius=8 and radius=20 for the same city won't hit cache. Consider caching after normalising to a coarser radius or share the raw Overpass response across radii.

server.py _osm_to_point() sets 'city' and 'postal_code' to '' when OSM tags don't include addr:city/addr:postcode — many OSM POIs lack these tags. Point cards then show 'undefined Paris' or empty fields in the address block. Consider populating city from a reverse-geocode fallback OR at least defaulting to the searched place name.

server.py: Overpass call has no retry — a single 502/504 fails the whole request. Given Overpass's flakiness on our shared cloud IP, adding 1-2 exponential backoff retries inside the endpoint would drastically improve UX. Currently the frontend must click Trouver again.
MapApp.js line 44+: liveMode state doesn't survive page reload. Users who share a URL in Réel mode land on Démo. Consider persisting the toggle in URL or localStorage.

MapApp.js: switching back to Démo does NOT reset ptype/carriers/tab-nearby state — user may see confusing '566 points dans 20km' instead of full 4127. Consider resetting or exposing a 'Réinitialiser filtres' button.
MapApp.js still ~695 lines with duplicated aside/mobile-sheet UI blocks — carrying over from iteration 9 review — consider SearchPanel extraction.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Live/OSM feature works end-to-end. Backend GET /api/live/points supports q OR lat/lng, radius (capped 25km), carriers, ptype filters; returns {center, points[], message?}. Point ids prefixed 'osm-'. Cache TTL 5min. Fixed bug: internal geocode() HTTPException no longer propagates through /api/live/points — now returns 200 + graceful message. Live GPS path (nearby-locate-btn) is more reliable for testing since q= depends on Nominatim which flakes on shared IPs. When testing live q= flow, warm cache via lat/lng first or expect skips.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG (found & fixed): /api/live/points?q=<place> returned HTTP 502 whenever Nominatim rate-limited the container IP (429), instead of gracefully returning 200 + message. RCA: server.py geocode() raises HTTPException(502) on Nominatim parse failure. live_points() called geocode() directly as a Python function, so the HTTPException propagated up and became the endpoint's own 502. REPRODUCTION: hit /api/live/points?q=Lyon repeatedly to trigger Nominatim rate-limit → 502. FIX: wrapped `geo = geocode(q)` in try/except HTTPException, returning {center:null, points:[], message:'Service de géocodage momentanément indisponible, réessayez'} on failure. VERIFIED: after fix, endpoint returns 200 with message when Nominatim is 429ing; previously returned 502. Frontend banner now shows a clearer message and the UI no longer looks 'broken'.
